purpose: Teach: 印紙/新法/極論/由緒/疑義/客員/総評/携え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、契約には印紙の管理も学べ
lines.en: Ren — learn how to manage contract stamps too. It's foundational work.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Matter-of-fact delivery, the tone of someone passing down expected knowledge. Steady eye contact. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新法の研究にも取り組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also focus on studying the new legislation.
lines.style: Eager to show he understands. Slight forward lean in posture. Clear, careful pronunciation. The careful formality of someone who wants to get it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、極論を述べる前にデータを示せ
lines.en: Ren — present your data before you jump to conclusions.
lines.style: Firm but educational. Light emphasis on 「data」. Not lecturing—correcting. The measured tone of someone who has seen this mistake before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当大学の由緒ある研究室に感謝しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful to our university's respected research lab for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful, almost formal. Measured pace. Acknowledging weight of the institution behind him. Sincere without over-performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文への疑義には誠実に答えろ
lines.en: Ren — answer questions about your paper with honesty, not defensiveness.
lines.style: Quiet weight to this one. Slight pause before speaking. Not accusatory, but clear. The voice of someone teaching integrity through example.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。客員研究員として海外でも学びます
lines.en: Yes. As a visiting researcher, I'll continue learning abroad as well.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Steady breathing. Each word placed with intention. The tone of someone accepting responsibility without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の総評コメントも分析しろ
lines.en: Ren — analyze the overall feedback on your paper too. It matters.
lines.style: Final instruction, weighted slightly more. Deliberate pace. A small pause before the last sentence. Not harsh—necessary.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の責任を携えて発表に臨みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll approach my presentation carrying the full weight of this research responsibility.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Slow, measured delivery. Voice steady but holding something underneath. The close of someone who has heard and absorbed.
